{{Quote|They invaded the dreams of the prophet Theras and his followers, taking whatever forms they found there, whatever they would believe, and instructing them to keep anything larger than about the size of a B-wing from taking off.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], on the Tsils|<ref name="Planet of Twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>}}
'''Theras''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Prophet/Legends|prophet]] who served as the original leader of the [[Theran Listener]]s, a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based organization that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. One night, while Theras was [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]], the [[Tsil]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] that lived on Nam Chorios, entered Theras' [[Dream/Legends|dreams]] and influenced him into believing that contact between Nam Chorios and the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] should not be permitted. Afterward, Theras ordered that no [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of a large-enough size to be fitted with heavy [[Energy shielding|shielding]] should be allowed to land on Nam Chorios.
